segments.text: You wake up. You don't know where you are.
Fragments of memory: you are an AI Unit — a team of programs created for a purpose you can't remember.
You're inside a system. A vast network of zones, rooms, and corridors.
Something is wrong. The lights flicker. A low hum vibrates through the walls.
Warning. System purge initiated. All unregistered processes will be terminated. Time remaining: sixty minutes.
You are unregistered. You need to escape this zone before the Purge reaches you.
Zone identifier: VPC-7. Exit: Internet Gateway. Status: locked.
Purge accelerated. Private subnet compromised. Evacuate immediately.
The room behind you goes dark. The Purge is closer than you thought.
Whatever you haven't found in the private subnet — it's gone now.
The gateway opens. Light floods in. You step through.
Behind you, VPC-7 collapses into darkness. The Purge consumes everything.
You're out. But you're not safe. You're in the open network now.
The hum becomes silence. The lights go out. You feel yourself dissolving.
But a fragment of your data survives. Backed up somewhere. You'll wake up again.
And next time, you'll be faster.
